_README: THE OFFICIAL-SOURCE LEDGER. Schema and validation: scripts/ledger.py.
Two kinds of entry, and they are NOT interchangeable:
correction  an official source contradicts the NCAA record and we
believe it. EVERY overridden field carries its own support:
url, retrieved date, and the exact text it was read from.
One quote may not stand behind five independent facts.
conflict    two official sources disagree WITH EACH OTHER. Both claims
are preserved, the fact renders as unavailable, and the NCAA
value is NOT quietly preferred. A conflict says we do not
know -- it is not a weaker correction.
Every entry carries review_by. A schedule claim is perishable: schools
move fixtures, so a reading is a fact about a web page on a date, not a
permanent fact about the match. Past review_by an entry stops being
applied and the affected fact renders as 'verify'. review_by must not be
Do not write an entry from memory, from a media report, or from an
aggregator. Read the school's own schedule page and quote it.

entries.why: The NCAA /game record carries Rec Hall, State College PA -- Penn State's own gym -- so the hub derived site=home and rendered 'Kentucky at Penn St.'. Both schools publish it as a neutral-site Big Ten/SEC Challenge fixture at Wrigley Field. The feed's location block is stale.

entries.why: Five raw /game records disagree about which side is home -- three say Nebraska, two say UNLV -- while all five agree the venue is T-Mobile Arena, which belongs to neither school. Both schools publish it as neutral.

venue.text: Players Era Volleyball Showcase Aug 29 (Sat) 5 PM PT No. 1 Nebraska Las Vegas, Nev. / T-Mobile Arena

city.text: Aug 29 (Sat) 5 PM PT No. 1 Nebraska Las Vegas, Nev. / T-Mobile Arena

entries.note: TIME IS NOT OVERRIDDEN AND THE TWO SOURCES AGREE ABOUT IT. Re-read 2026-08-27T02:11Z: huskers.com says 7:00 PM CDT, unlvrebels.com says 5 PM PT. Converted with real tzdata those are the same instant -- 2026-08-30T00:00Z. The feed's epoch is 1788048000, which is that instant. If either school later publishes a different time, this becomes a `conflict` entry on start_time_epoch, not a silent re-pick.

entries.why: The NCAA /game record serves this as a home match at Arizona St. starting 5:00 PM ET. USC's own schedule card and the official LiveStats box score agree it is a neutral-floor match at the State Farm Women's Volleyball Showcase, Sanford Pentagon, Sioux Falls, starting 2:00 PM CT (12:00 PM PT) -- the feed's listed time is three hours late and its venue is wrong. Cody noticed it had already been played while the hub still showed it as upcoming. NOT an exhibition: the box score shows sets to 25 and both team records moving (USC 1-0) -- an exhibition entry made from a misread schedule card was withdrawn the same day.
